selection_basis: LIBERO_OBJECT benchmark task map and BDDL instructions, obj_of_interest declarations, and target_object_region placement; no rollout outcome was consulted.

preflight_visibility_check.method: Render init state 0 at canonical 512x512 agentview with no semantic control actions, then manually inspect the image.
preflight_visibility_check.result: The named target is directly visible in the initial agentview for every selected task.

task_selection_rules: Keep task 2 as the verified anchor task.
Select tasks from the same basic pick-up-and-place manipulation family.
Require one explicit primary manipuland in the instruction and BDDL.
Exclude articulation and multi-stage visibility prerequisites.
Prefer target classes with different visual form factors.
Use the same ordered init-state indices 0, 1, and 2 for the initial gate.

tasks.instruction: Pick the salad dressing and place it in the basket
tasks.reason_for_inclusion: Anchor task 2 has the existing six-state positive ALIGN evidence and uses the benchmark's direct floor-to-basket pick-and-place family.
tasks.initial_observation_basis: Manually inspected canonical init-state-0 agentview; the dressing bottle is visible. BDDL also declares it as an object of interest in target_object_region.

tasks.instruction: Pick the alphabet soup and place it in the basket
tasks.reason_for_inclusion: Same single-stage floor-to-basket family, one named manipuland, and a can-shaped visual category distinct from the anchor container.
tasks.initial_observation_basis: Manually inspected canonical init-state-0 agentview; the soup can is visible. BDDL also declares it as an object of interest in target_object_region.

tasks.reason_for_inclusion: Same single-stage floor-to-basket family, one named manipuland, and a compact box-like visual form distinct from bottle/can categories.

tasks.instruction: Pick the milk and place it in the basket
tasks.reason_for_inclusion: Same single-stage floor-to-basket family, one named manipuland, and a tall carton form distinct from the anchor and other selected targets.

initial_gate.expansion_rule: Expand a task to init states 0-5 only if its initial three episodes all show positive episode-level net alignment improvement and no task-specific runtime change.
